notes.title: Update: December 23
notes.content:
- Leaderboard has been opened.
- Fixed damage calculation of Blade weapon.
- Fixed a bug in movie playback.
- Fixed other minor bugs.

notes.title: Update: November 5
notes.content:
Adjustments have been made to the weapons.
- The initial power of all weapons has been increased to make it easier to regain control.
- The attack power of the "Rainbow" has been strengthened and its range slightly increased.
- The initial attack of the "Blade" has been strengthened. Its power is reduced each time it penetrates.

Adjustments have been made to the bosses.
- The clouds of the copy-boss in Stage 5 (Hard) will not hit for a while when they appears.
- The attacks of the Stage 6 boss has been eased, to make it easier to avoid and to reduce the processing load.

Bug fixes have been made.
- Fixed a bug that the secret condition could be obtained even though it has not been achieved.
- Fixed behavior of stage 5 mid-boss when it is escaping.
Fixed other bugs

notes.title: Update: October 28
notes.content:
- The attack of the Stage 4 boss has been adjusted.
- Adjusted the placement of text displayed in the speech balloons
- A dialog box is now displayed when opening the Factory or a new stage.
- Fixed other bugs

notes.title: Update: October 25
notes.content:
Bug fixes:
- Some bosses sometimes failed to take any damage.
- Sometimes caused shots to jam.
- Adjusted the timing of some hints of Secret.
and other bug fixes.

notes.title: Update: October 19
notes.content:
Adjusted the scoring system.
Increased the weight of the bonus of closed destroying enemies and adjusted the system for more high-risk, high-return score earning.

notes.title: Update: October 9
notes.content:
The following problems have been fixed and adjusted
- When returning from a store-ship, etc, Nozomi could get stuck in a wall and get hit at the edge of the screen.
- Some enemy did not attack correctly.
- Correction of the formula for calculating bomb shots.
- Fixed the position of the core of the round turret in Stage 6.
- Sometimes causes the visibility of Harpoon to not play correctly.
- Fixed slow resumption of scrolling after mid-boss battle.
- Other minor fixes.

notes.title: Update: October 9
notes.content:
The following problems have been fixed
- The game becomes impossible to progress in Stage 3 of Easy Mode.
- Other bug fixes.

notes.title: Update: October 7
notes.content:
The following function have been added
- Button settings (can be set from the Setting menu)

Fixed the following bugs
- The parts shot by a harpoon remained on the screen.
- Could operate in the title screen after exit.
- When taking a screenshot with the F12 key while shooting a harpoon, the harpoon is no longer released.

notes.title: Update: October 1
notes.content:
Bug fixed
-Sometimes, the bomb shot does not release.
